thread:
ronald.g: Ops asked for a simple runtime decision flow to pick fp8/int8/4bit. want: cheap on-path check + sampled assurance. any red flags?
maria.chen: Keep the on-path check stateless-ish and O(1). prefer margin or single-token score derived from the low-bit logits. no second evaluation.
esha.v: Agreed. margin = top1 - top2 logit. Normalize with per-endpoint EMA mean/std to form z. thresholding on z is simple.
maria.chen: For hosted scale, EMA per-instance is fine. For dedicated customers centralize stats (redis) to get tighter thresholds.
ronald.g: Telemetry fields ops needs: precision_selected, margin_z, gate_action (allow|fallback), sample_id for replays. small and queryable.
eshe.v: Also include sample_type: fast_probe|gold_check and fallback_reason string. golden checks should be sparse (0.1%-1%) and run async with full-precision.
maria.chen: Golden checks act as the safety net. if golden_check_failure_rate exceeds configured tolerance -> trigger auto-rollback to safer precision and page.
ronald.g: Config model idea: CSV allowed_precisions; margin_z_threshold; golden_check_rate; mode (local|central); emergency_pin (bool). expose in console as sliders mapping to these keys.
eshe.v: Implementation: compute margin from logits returned by low-bit pass. z = (margin - ema_mean)/ema_std. if z < threshold -> mark for fallback and enqueue golden_check. decide_precision consults customer_tier before final decision.
maria.chen: Need an opt-out header x-precision-pin for customers who want fixed precision. Also record audit log entries for compliance.
ronald.g: Perf note: margin computation is cheap (~tens of microseconds). adding EMA update is similar cost. should fit SLO.
eshe.v: Edgecases: adversarial prompts can manipulate margin. golden checks with a small curated prompt set can catch systematic regressions. log failing sample_ids for replay.
maria.chen: Rollout plan: 1) margin gate local EMA in staging; 2) enable golden checks on a small sample; 3) run experiment with telemetry for 2 weeks; 4) enable central stats for top customers. keep rollback path clear.
ronald.g: I'll prototype decide_precision API: decide_precision(request_meta, logits, ema_stats) -> precision:string, reason:string. deterministic and idempotent.
runtime-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: margin-gate-experiment v0.2 -> staging at 2024-11-03T01:00Z :rocket:
maria.chen: Thanks. I'll add the config schema to the RFC follow-up and include expected metrics: cost_savings_pct, fallback_rate, golden_failure_rate.
eshe.v: +1. small, observable, reversible.
ronald.g: posting perf numbers later today
